title: React screens that talk to an API
description: Kilnworth Pottery has a JSON API for its workshops, and Ivo still needs the sign-up screen that uses it: this week's workshops with their day, price and places left, and a way to book a place. You build that screen in React, one issue at a time, against a stand-in of the studio's API that can be slow, fail or answer late. You learn to load data in a component, show loading and error states, send a form without sending it twice, keep the screen in step with the server, and handle answers that arrive out of order.
